Read [../../.brain/NextSteps.md](../../.brain/NextSteps.md), [../../.brain/Progress.md](../../.brain/Progress.md), [../../.brain/ExamTracker.md](../../.brain/ExamTracker.md), [../../.brain/StudyPlan.md](../../.brain/StudyPlan.md), [../../.brain/Syllabus.md](../../.brain/Syllabus.md), [../../.brain/WeakAreas.md](../../.brain/WeakAreas.md), [../../.brain/MockTestLog.md](../../.brain/MockTestLog.md), [../../.brain/TrackedJobs.md](../../.brain/TrackedJobs.md), and [../../combined-HAL-then-IOCL-plan.md](../../combined-HAL-then-IOCL-plan.md).

Then determine what should be updated based on the session outcome.

- Keep dates consistent with current date (today 01 Sept 2026, Phase 6 HAL sprint live).
- Keep the active phase and exam priorities internally consistent across Progress.md, ExamTracker.md, StudyPlan.md, and NextSteps.md — and consistent with `combined-HAL-then-IOCL-plan.md`.
- Keep `.brain/NextSteps.md` aligned with the real immediate next action after the session (day-by-day sprint in combined plan).
- Preserve history — append sessions, don't overwrite. Update streak, Last 7 Days summary, and phase completion.
- If a mock/CBT score changes the picture, update MockTestLog.md and WeakAreas.md with topic breakdown and next repair action.
- If an admin gate moves (ISRO/CONCOR/HAL call letter/IOCL admit card), update ExamTracker.md and TrackedJobs.md together.
- Only suggest updates that are justified by the session evidence. Separate Confirmed from Inferred.
